title: Gold Master
tagline: Deadline day at Dalex Software, and the courier will not wait!
blurb: Deadline day at Dalex Software, and the courier will not wait! Steer Mo round seven rooms on three floors, carrying the work from desk to desk, brewing the tea, squashing the bugs and shooing the cat. Four games to ship, a review mark for each, and a Relaxed game for those who hate a ticking clock.
controls: Walk up, down, left, right (two together for diagonals)

credits.name: Kev Mallin, Prue Fairley and Stan Hollis for INK & PAPER
